title: fix(service-analytics)!: the dataset draft preview mints and judges an undeclared measure as the live strategies do, so a misspelled measure is refused INVALID_FIELD instead of answered as a row count
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DLMAJ9kZMBicdMLygftCdLd)_

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyQNVxpxREGfKkTsqs

Fixes #28172

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — a draft-preview dataset query (`queryDataset` with `previewDrafts: true` over a pending seed draft) now refuses a selected measure that the native and ObjectQL strategies refuse, which it served as a row count before. No export, answer member, status or error code is added: the refusals are the live faces' existing `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 and `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：数据集草稿预览遇到数据集未声明的度量，过去一律按 `count(*)` 给行数；现在按实时查询同一套铸造规则（`<字段>_sum` 等后缀、裸字段名即求和）生成度量，并在读种子行前过实时查询的同一组度量闸门。拼错的 `nope`、`ghost_avg` 现在与实时一样按 400 `INVALID_FIELD` 拒，消息逐字相同；`amount_sum`、`amount` 现在给出与实时相同的 SUM 值，不再是行数。
- 为什么改：草稿里的错别字显示一个看似合理的数，发布后才被拒；能用的推断度量在草稿里也显示错的数。
- 风险与回滚：只影响草稿预览路径上未声明的度量；已声明度量、时长度量、派生度量和 `count` 不变，实时策略不变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts` 里 `answerDataset` 的 `previewService.query`（新增的铸造与闸门），同文件 `mintCallerMeasures`（从 `ensureCube` 抽出的共用循环）；`preview-evaluator.ts` 的度量聚合步。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/preview-undeclared-measure-parity.test.ts`，预期 10 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The draft preview's measure step (`analytics-service.ts`, `answerDataset` → `previewService.query`).** Before evaluating seed rows, the preview now does for a measure the dataset does not declare what the published path's `ensureCube` does:

- mints it with `mintCallerMeasures`, the loop `ensureCube` ran inline, now extracted and shared by both: the `<cube>.` qualifier rule (`mintableMeasureKey`, a dotted non-qualifier measure refused), then `inferMeasure`'s suffix convention (`_sum` / `_avg` / `_min` / `_max` / `_count_distinct`, a bare name meaning its sum, a spelling that names no field refused). Declared measures, declared dotted keys and dataset duration measures are never minted, as before;
- asks `assertMeasureFields` (#4437): a source field the object does not have is refused `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 with the same message, `Valid measures:` listing the declared ones;
- asks the measure position of the #21156 column-reference gate, extracted from `assertCallerMembersResolvable` as `assertCallerMeasuresResolvable` (no behaviour change on the live path): a spelling that is not a column reference (`amount + 1`) is refused `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403;
- asks the #21044 aggregate × field-type door (`assertMeasureFieldTypes`), which the live path asks in `ensureCube`: `region_sum` over a text field is refused `INVALID_FIELD` / 400, where the preview would otherwise sum no number and read `0`;
- hands the cube WITH the minted measures to the preview's existing gates (stored-body, internal-field, field-level read, record-currency) and to the evaluator, as the live gates read the cube after `ensureCube`. So a minted measure is judged by the field it aggregates: `secret_sum` is refused 403 when the caller may not read `secret`. Without this, minting on the preview would sum a field the field gate never saw (`namedQueryFields` skips a measure the cube does not carry).

**The evaluator (`preview-evaluator.ts`, `evaluateAnalyticsQueryOverRows`).** A measure the cube it is handed does not carry is refused `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 (`invalidMemberError`, member and valid measures named) instead of being read as `count(*)`. The production caller never reaches it now (it hands over the minted cube); it stops the silent fallback from coming back.

**Answers that change value.** On the preview, an inferred measure over a real field (`amount_sum`, `amount`, …) now answers the live value instead of a row count. The changeset says so.

**Unchanged.** Declared, duration and derived measures, the undeclared `count`, and both live strategies.

**Not in this PR.** An undeclared DIMENSION has the same gap on the preview (`dimensions: ['bogus']` is refused `INVALID_FIELD` live and served as one `null` group on the preview). Measured here, reported to the seat and carded as #28201.

## Why

Measured on `main` `35f20551`, real SQLite engine, a dataset declaring `total` (sum of `amount`) and `deals` (count), `dimensions: ['region']`:

| measure | native | ObjectQL | draft preview (before) | draft preview (after) |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `nope` | `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 | `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 | `{amer: 2, emea: 1}` | `INVALID_FIELD` / 400, same message |
| `ghost_avg` | `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 | `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 | `{amer: 2, emea: 1}` | `INVALID_FIELD` / 400, same message |
| `amount_sum` | `{amer: 150, emea: 30}` | `{amer: 150, emea: 30}` | `{amer: 2, emea: 1}` | `{amer: 150, emea: 30}` |
| `amount` | `{amer: 150, emea: 30}` | `{amer: 150, emea: 30}` | `{amer: 2, emea: 1}` | `{amer: 150, emea: 30}` |
| `region_sum` (text) | `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 | `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 | `{amer: 2, emea: 1}` | `INVALID_FIELD` / 400, same message |
| `amount + 1` | `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403 | `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403 | `{amer: 2, emea: 1}` | `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403, same message |
| `total` (declared), `count` | served | served | served, same values | served, same values |

The live faces do not refuse every undeclared measure: they infer one over a real field. So the triage rule ("refuses a measure the dataset does not declare with the live faces' envelope … pin native, ObjectQL and draft-preview parity") is implemented as parity: the preview refuses exactly what the live faces refuse, with their envelope, and serves what they serve. The seat confirmed this reading before the fix.

## Verification

- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/preview-undeclared-measure-parity.test.ts` (new, 10, real SQLite engine through `queryDataset`, each case on all three faces): `nope` and `ghost_avg` refused `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 with `param`, `field`, `measure` and a message identical across native, ObjectQL and preview; `amount_sum` and `amount` served `{amer: 150, emea: 30}`; `region_sum` refused `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 and `amount + 1` refused `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403, preview message identical to native; CONTROLS: declared `total` and undeclared `count` serve the same values on every face; the evaluator refuses an uncarried measure (and serves a carried one); a minted `secret_sum` is refused `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403 naming `secret` on the preview and on a live strategy when the caller may not read `secret`.
- Ablations (each on the source, pins rerun): both source files reset to `main` ⇒ 8 red, the 2 CONTROLs green (one of the 8, the field-read case, was added after this run and is covered by ablation A); A: the preview's field-read gate given the cube without the minted measures ⇒ the `secret_sum` case red; B: no field-type door on the preview ⇒ the `region_sum` case red; C: no caller-measure gate on the preview ⇒ the `amount + 1` case red; D: no `assertMeasureFields` on the preview ⇒ the `nope` and `ghost_avg` cases red. Every added gate's pin bites on its own.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run` at head (merged with `main` `1e45a4e1`): 198 files, 4788 passed, 282 skipped, 0 failed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics typecheck` and eslint on the touched files clean.
- `check-issue-citations` and `check:doc-authoring` green at head. Every `dispatch-gates --commands` family (62), `pnpm lint` and the dogfood battery run at the final head: the readings are posted on the card with the os-dev report.

Skills-docs: none. `git grep -n -i -E "previewDrafts|draft (data )?preview" -- skills content/docs` (references excluded) finds `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx:146` (the currency door covers the preview: still true) and release notes; nothing in `skills/` or `content/docs/` describes how the preview answers an undeclared measure.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the lane's maintainer summary).
